entries.text: You see a devout Children of the Cathedral Member.
entries.source_text: You see a devout Children of the Cathedral Member.

entries.text: 你看到一名大教堂的虔诚教徒。
entries.source_text: 你看到一名大教堂的虔诚教徒。

entries.text: We offer healing of the body to heal the spirit. Can I help you?
entries.source_text: We offer healing of the body to heal the spirit. Can I help you?

entries.text: 我们可以帮助治疗受伤的身体和精神，你需要帮助吗？
entries.source_text: 我们可以帮助治疗受伤的身体和精神，你需要帮助吗？

entries.text: Yes. Help me.
entries.source_text: Yes. Help me.

entries.text: 是的，请帮我。
entries.source_text: 是的，请帮我。

entries.text: Who are you people?
entries.source_text: Who are you people?

entries.text: 你们是谁？
entries.source_text: 你们是谁？

entries.text: Uhn.
entries.source_text: Uhn.

entries.text: 哦。
entries.source_text: 哦。

entries.text: That is fine, my child. We will examine you now.
entries.source_text: That is fine, my child. We will examine you now.

entries.text: 很好，孩子，我现在就给你做检查。
entries.source_text: 很好，孩子，我现在就给你做检查。

entries.text: Blessed are the meek of mind. There is nothing wrong with you,# my child. Run along and play.
entries.source_text:
Blessed are the meek of mind. There is nothing wrong with you,
# my child. Run along and play.

entries.text: 恭顺的人会有好报。你没有受任何伤，我的孩子。去玩吧。
entries.source_text: 恭顺的人会有好报。你没有受任何伤，我的孩子。去玩吧。

entries.text: You have been healed. Be more careful in the future.
entries.source_text: You have been healed. Be more careful in the future.

entries.text: 你的伤治好了。以后要小心。
entries.source_text: 你的伤治好了。以后要小心。

entries.text: You are wounded.
entries.source_text: You are wounded.

entries.text: 你受伤了。
entries.source_text: 你受伤了。

entries.text: You are not wounded. That is good.
entries.source_text: You are not wounded. That is good.

entries.text: 你没受伤，很好。
entries.source_text: 你没受伤，很好。

entries.text: I see you are poisoned.
entries.source_text: I see you are poisoned.

entries.text: 看得出，你中毒了。
entries.source_text: 看得出，你中毒了。

entries.text: Hmm, some radiation poisoning. Unfortunately, we cannot cure that.
entries.source_text: Hmm, some radiation poisoning. Unfortunately, we cannot cure that.

entries.text: 嗯，你被辐射了。抱歉，我们治不了这个。
entries.source_text: 嗯，你被辐射了。抱歉，我们治不了这个。

entries.text: We require a donation of $
entries.source_text: We require a donation of $

entries.text: before we can heal you. Is this acceptable?

entries.source_text: 元才能给你治伤。可以吗？

entries.text: Yes.

entries.text: 好。

entries.text: No.

entries.text: 不干。
entries.source_text: 不干。

entries.text: But I don't have that kind of money!
entries.source_text: But I don't have that kind of money!

entries.text: 可是我没那么多钱啊。
entries.source_text: 可是我没那么多钱啊。

entries.text: Will you take $
entries.source_text: Will you take $

entries.text: 要不给你
entries.source_text: 要不给你

entries.text: 元？
entries.source_text: 元？

entries.text: The Children do not haggle. Now, will you accept our price?
entries.source_text: The Children do not haggle. Now, will you accept our price?

entries.text: 我们不讨价还价。你到底接不接受这个价格？
entries.source_text: 我们不讨价还价。你到底接不接受这个价格？

entries.text: Yes, of course I will
entries.source_text: Yes, of course I will

entries.text: 好，当然。
entries.source_text: 好，当然。

entries.text: No thank you.
entries.source_text: No thank you.

entries.text: 不，谢了。
entries.source_text: 不，谢了。

entries.text: Thank you, my son. Let us pray for your healing.
entries.source_text: Thank you, my son. Let us pray for your healing.

entries.text: 谢谢，我的孩子，那我们开始治疗吧。
entries.source_text: 谢谢，我的孩子，那我们开始治疗吧。

entries.text: Thank you, my daughter. Let us pray for your healing.
entries.source_text: Thank you, my daughter. Let us pray for your healing.

entries.source_text: 谢谢，我的孩子，那我们开始治疗吧。

entries.text: There you go. Peace and blessings of the Children go with you.
entries.source_text: There you go. Peace and blessings of the Children go with you.

entries.text: 好了。愿教徒的和平和祝福永远伴随你。
entries.source_text: 好了。愿教徒的和平和祝福永远伴随你。

entries.text: You do not have enough money. If you donate all you can, we# will heal you. Is this acceptable?

You do not have enough money. If you donate all you can, we

entries.text: 你的钱不够，那你捐出所有的钱，我们还是愿意给你治疗的，可以吗？

entries.source_text: 捐出你所有的钱，我们就给你治疗的，可以吗？

You have more than enough to make the donation. You need schooling
# in math, my child.

entries.text: 你的钱是有能力捐助的，你应该好好学学数学，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 你的钱是有能力捐助的，你应该好好学学数学，我的孩子。

entries.text: We are the Children of the Cathedral. We live and work amongst those# unfortunates living in the wasteland. If you ever get to the Boneyard,# stop by the Cathedral.
entries.source_text:
We are the Children of the Cathedral. We live and work amongst those
# unfortunates living in the wasteland. If you ever get to the Boneyard,
# stop by the Cathedral.

entries.text: 我们是大教堂的教徒。我们和废土上受难的人们一起生活和奋斗。如果你到了晒骨场，可以去教堂参观一下。
entries.source_text: 我们是大教堂的教徒。我们和废土上受难的人们一起生活和奋斗。如果你到了晒骨场，可以去教堂参观一下。

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.source_text: Thank you.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: What do you do?
entries.source_text: What do you do?

entries.text: 你是干什么的？
entries.source_text: 你是干什么的？

entries.text: We are the healers and teachers of peace. We heal the body to heal# the spirit. All we ask is a small donation to pay for our healing# supplies.
entries.source_text:
We are the healers and teachers of peace. We heal the body to heal
# the spirit. All we ask is a small donation to pay for our healing
# supplies.

entries.text: 我们是医疗师，也是和平的布道者。我们治疗身体的伤痛，也治疗人们的灵魂。我们只要求一点点相当于医疗成本的捐献。
entries.source_text: 我们是医疗师，也是和平的布道者。我们治疗身体的伤痛，也治疗人们的灵魂。我们只要求一点点相当于医疗成本的捐献。

entries.text: Sounds like a good idea to me.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a good idea to me.

entries.text: 听起来很不错。
entries.source_text: 听起来很不错。

entries.text: Sounds like a load of crap, if you ask me.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a load of crap, if you ask me.

entries.text: 我看这都是胡说八道。
entries.source_text: 我看这都是胡说八道。

entries.text: We did not ask you. I can tell you are tired of listening to# our beliefs. If you need anything else, we will be here.
entries.source_text:
We did not ask you. I can tell you are tired of listening to
# our beliefs. If you need anything else, we will be here.

entries.text: 我们不管你怎么想。你大概不愿意听我讲信仰问题了。那么，如有需要，欢迎你来找我们。
entries.source_text: 我们不管你怎么想。你大概不愿意听我讲信仰问题了。那么，如有需要，欢迎你来找我们。

entries.text: It is the most holy of ideas. We are working towards ultimate# peace in the wasteland. All creatures shall live as one.
entries.source_text:
It is the most holy of ideas. We are working towards ultimate
# peace in the wasteland. All creatures shall live as one.

entries.text: 这是最崇高的信念！我们致力于废土的最终和平。所有生物都会化为一身。
entries.source_text: 这是最崇高的信念！我们致力于废土的最终和平。所有生物都会化为一身。

entries.text: Thank you. Good day.
entries.source_text: Thank you. Good day.

entries.text: 谢谢，再见！
entries.source_text: 谢谢，再见！

entries.text: We have no time to talk. We are leaving. This place is# dangerous for us.
entries.source_text:
We have no time to talk. We are leaving. This place is
# dangerous for us.

entries.text: 没时间聊天了。我们要走了，这地方太危险了。
entries.source_text: 没时间聊天了。我们要走了，这地方太危险了。

entries.text: Why are you doing this? We will do you no harm!
entries.source_text: Why are you doing this? We will do you no harm!

entries.text: 你为什么要这么做？我们又没伤害你！
entries.source_text: 你为什么要这么做？我们又没伤害你！

entries.text: 我可以告诉你：Cathedral-大教堂、Mutants-变种人、Master-主教、Boneyard-晒骨场、Followers-末世论者、Chip-芯片、Apocalypse-末世论、Necropolis-大墓地城、Set-赛特、Watershed-水处理房、Hall-亡者大厅。
